jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, External Services, AWS Billing
jobs.description:
Description

We're building the next generation of AWS enterprise contract automation, making deal creation autonomous, intelligent, and self-service. You'll define the AI-powered platform behind billions of dollars in AWS private pricing agreements, serving customers from mid-market companies to the world's largest enterprises. This is the foundation for how customers commit to AWS and how AWS delivers on those commitments accurately and at scale.

As Principal Product Manager - Technical External Services, you'll define the future of our contract automation platform including AI-powered systems that can draft, simulate, negotiate, ingest, and validate contracts without manual intervention. You'll define how AWS represents commercial intent as structured data, establish governed libraries of reusable contract terms and negotiation policies, architect the guardrails that make autonomous contract generation safe, and build the self-service experiences that let customers of different size configure and commit to agreements through digital channels. Your work directly determines how quickly AWS can close enterprise deals, whether contracts produce accurate billing from day one, and whether customers can self-serve commitments without sales engagement.

In this role, you'll define product strategy that spans multiple years, driving initiatives that fundamentally change how enterprise agreements flow through AWS. You'll architect complex data models for ambiguous commercial domains, design how AI agents generate and negotiate contracts within defined boundaries, and build simulation and decision-support capabilities that help deal teams model revenue impact and make better commercial decisions before committing. You'll establish the mechanisms — operating cadences, metrics, escalation paths — that make contract automation delivery repeatable across multiple organizations. You'll conduct direct research with deal teams, enterprise customers, and commercial operations teams to understand where the contracting process creates friction, translating those insights into product requirements.

You'll collaborate with engineering teams across AWS's billing, agreements, and commercial operations organizations, as well as applied science teams building the AI models that power drafting and negotiation. You'll partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align contract automation with go-to-market strategy for enterprise and mid-market segments. You'll mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar across the organization. This role requires deep understanding of how AI agent systems work and how to constrain them safely, combined with the cross-organizational influence to bring diverse stakeholders together around a common vision.

If you're passionate about building systems that fundamentally change how enterprises transact in the cloud, and excited about defining how AI transforms the most complex commercial negotiations at scale, this role offers the chance to create AWS's contract automation platform from the ground up — serving everyone from deal negotiators managing billion-dollar relationships to mid-market customers self-serving their first private pricing agreement.

Define product strategy spanning multiple years, driving contract automation initiatives from concept through production
Architect the machine-readable data model that represents AWS's commercial agreements as structured, actionable data, including reusable contract terms and policy rules
Design AI-powered contract generation and negotiation experiences with appropriate guardrails and escalation mechanisms
Define self-service contract experiences for enterprise and mid-market customers
Build simulation and data-driven decision-support capabilities for deal teams
Establish mechanisms that make cross-organizational delivery repeatable
Conduct direct research with deal teams and enterprise customers to validate product direction
Partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align with go-to-market strategy
Mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar

jobs.description:
About Us

Applecart
is the leading technology company that C-suites rely on to reach business-critical decision makers. The most important decisions are made by the hardest people to reach and influence. Historically, C-suite leaders have lacked the tools to reach the stakeholders who matter most to their business. The C-suites of hundreds of Fortune 500 companies, major agencies, trade associations, nonprofits, and governments use Applecart to put their best content in front of business-critical decision makers and those they trust — from policymakers and investors to CEOs, key employees, members of the media and more. Decision makers are informed by what they read, learn from advisors, hear from colleagues, and discuss with family and friends. To break through to them, you must reach them through the only channel that really moves them: those they know and trust. Applecart’s platform uses publicly available data to map billions of social relationships between nearly every American adult and enable clients to deliver content directly to decision makers and those who matter most to them.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management, Measurement in our New York City office.

About The Role

Our Decision Maker Targeting products are a critical part of our clients’ strategic execution. Applecart is used as an amplification layer for their ongoing communications with a broad cross-section of key stakeholders. Quantifying the impact of using Applecart audiences across all of these communication strategies is essential to our clients’ success.

In this critical role, you will drive the product vision and execution of our measurement and insights products as we grow our offering and client base. The ideal candidate would combine enterprise product expertise with a deep technical understanding of media measurement and/or research methods.

What You’ll Do

Define and build the next generation of our Measurement & Optimization offerings in collaboration with a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, product managers, and sales and client service leads
Own the product strategy, business planning, roadmap and requirements definition for your own product offering
Evangelize product solutions with internal teams, clients and industry partners
Collect user and client feedback via both direct and indirect channels and translate them into product requirements where applicable
Collaborate with key clients on implementation strategy and adoption of new features
Manage high visibility product launches and define and track KPIs to measure success and identify ongoing improvements
This role may also manage 1-2 Product Managers under them

Experiences And Capabilities You Bring

Experience and domain expertise:

8+ years of experience in a product management role, including 3+ years managing direct reports
Deep understanding of digital marketing, advertising technology, market research, or a similar industry, with specific expertise in media effectiveness measurement
Hands-on familiarity with the data that flows out of the ad tech stack — DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP), ad servers, and SSPs —including log-level/impression-level data, bid and delivery signals, and audience and taxonomy data
Personally rolled out measurement technology solutions to large enterprises and/or their agencies, owning both the client-facing reporting layer and the underlying methodology

Leading Mixed-discipline Teams

Proven track record leading mixed-discipline teams where you are the connective tissue between functions — partnering with data scientists on methodology and model validation, with analysts on insight generation and QA, with engineers on data pipelines and platform tradeoffs, and mentoring junior PMs on scoping and execution
You can translate a statistical approach into a client-ready narrative, and a client asks into a well-specified technical requirement
Experience working closely and managing asynchronous communication with a geographically distributed team

Technical Depth

Strong SQL — you write your own queries against large datasets to validate outputs, size opportunities, and debug discrepancies rather than waiting on a ticket
Experience owning products built on big-data platforms such as Spark/Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake, with a working understanding of batch vs. streaming, partitioning, cost/performance tradeoffs, and why a pipeline change can move a client-facing number
Experience shipping a client-facing application end to end — you have owned a standalone product surface, not just a reporting feed or an internal tool. That includes partnering with design on information architecture and UX for complex, data-dense interfaces; making deliberate calls on self-serve vs. guided workflows; and handling the realities of a production app such as onboarding, permissions and multi-tenancy, performance under real query loads, and instrumentation to understand how clients actually use it

This is a hybrid role. Work from home on Monday and Friday and in Applecart’s New York City office Tuesday through Thursday.

Compensation

Our compensation package consists of three components: (i) a base salary, (ii) annual cash bonus, and (iii) generous equity compensation.

The base salary range for this role is between $220,000 to $250,000, based on the candidate's experience and skills relative to the requirements listed above. The salary range provided is exclusive of discretionary annual cash bonus and equity compensation. The salary range provided for this role is specific to candidates located in the New York City area.

Applecart’s platform has been used by hundreds of industry-leading clients spanning Fortune 500 companies like Blackstone and Intuit, leading nonprofit organizations like the Environmental Defense Fund, and top-tier advertising and communications agencies like Teneo, FGS, Weber Shandwick, and OMD.
Applecart is growing quickly — over the last 4 years, we’ve increased our revenue by 10X, grown our headcount by almost 5X, and we’re cashflow positive.
Our senior leadership team includes two members of the Forbes 30 under 30 list for Marketing and Advertising, the former Head of Product at Moat, Oracle’s online ad measurement platform, a former senior White House advisor, early sales and talent leaders from Google and Twitter, two of the Democratic Party’s most successful pollsters and strategists, and alums of top-tier organizations like Bain & Company, Amazon and Simpson Thacher.
Applecart raised a $100M Series C from Blackstone’s tech growth fund at the end of 2025. The company’s other investors include Bain & Company, global sports, entertainment and marketing giant Endeavor, KKR Co-Founder Henry Kravis, entrepreneur Chris Burch, a founder of Palantir, senior engineering leaders at Twitter and Yelp, former Fortune 50 and advertising agency CEOs, and a number of well-known venture capitalists. Ari Emanuel, CEO of TKO and Executive Chairman of WME, Wayne Berman, Blackstone’s Head of Global Government Affairs, and Risa Heller, CEO of HELLER, serve on our board.
Our work has been featured on Morning Joe on MSNBC, BloombergTV, and The Colbert Report, and in Axios, Semafor, BusinessWeek, the Associated Press, Forbes, the Washington Post, and Politico, among many others.

to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

YipitData is building the default intelligence platform for anyone evaluating companies and markets. Our data feeds are central to that ambition, bringing proprietary and exclusively licensed data directly into our clients’ research, investment, and business workflows.

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead and grow our Data Feeds product management team. You will own the strategy and performance of a portfolio of data products, develop a strong team of PMs, and help build a more connected, scalable feeds business serving fundamental investors, quantitative and systematic funds, and corporate customers.

This is a player-coach role
. Alongside managing the team and setting portfolio direction, you will directly own a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative - from customer discovery and product strategy through development, launch, and ongoing performance. You should enjoy moving between portfolio decisions, coaching PMs, and working through the details of a product yourself.

Our opportunity extends beyond bringing more datasets to market. We are building differentiated products around clear customer problems, combining data and capabilities where they create greater value, and making our feeds easier to evaluate, integrate, and use. You will help determine where we invest, how our products fit together, and how we translate our data advantage into durable growth.

As Our Group Product Manager, Data Feeds, You Will:

Lead and Develop the Product Team

Manage, coach, and grow a team of product managers, strengthening their customer discovery, strategic judgment, execution, and commercial ownership.
Establish clear product responsibilities, goals, and decision-making expectations, giving PMs the autonomy and support to own their products.
Build effective practices for planning, roadmap reviews, customer feedback, and performance measurement.
Recruit and develop talent as the team grows, while maintaining a high bar for product thinking and accountability.

Lead Product Portfolio Strategy and Execution

Own a cohesive product portfolio strategy aligned with the broader business direction set by the Head of Data Feeds, defining how our feeds fit together, serve customer needs, and deliver differentiated value.
Guide PMs in developing product visions and roadmaps that strengthen both their individual products and the overall portfolio.
Prioritize across product roadmaps and shared capabilities, balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, and available resources; partner with the Head of Data Feeds on broader investment decisions.
Work with PMs to validate use cases and commercial demand early, including during the evaluation of new data sources.
Identify portfolio gaps, overlap, and opportunities to combine datasets, reuse methodologies, and extend products across customer segments.
Use customer feedback and product performance to recommend which offerings to scale, improve, consolidate, or retire, and lead execution of agreed decisions.

Directly Own and Build Products

Serve as the hands-on PM for a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative, owning its vision, roadmap, requirements, and outcomes.
Lead customer discovery, investigate the underlying data, and translate customer needs into clear product decisions.
Partner with Data, Engineering, Data Science, and Quant Research to assess feasibility, shape requirements, and bring products to market.
Stay close to client evaluations and integrations, using feedback to improve the product and establish practices the broader team can reuse.

Drive Commercial Performance

Share accountability with commercial partners for portfolio revenue growth, retention, expansion, and product economics.
Partner with Revenue, Client Strategy, Product Marketing, and Solutions Consulting on pricing, packaging, positioning, and effective sales and evaluation processes.
Build a clear portfolio story that helps customers understand which products meet their needs and how those products work together.
Balance near-term client requests with repeatable market opportunities, ensuring commitments inform a scalable roadmap.
Define and track success through customer adoption, evaluation conversion, time to value, retention, and commercial results.

Build a Consistent, Reliable Client Experience

Establish product expectations for data quality, coverage, timeliness, documentation, and delivery across the portfolio.
Partner with Data and Engineering on quality controls, monitoring, change management, and issue resolution.
Improve how customers discover, evaluate, onboard, integrate, and receive ongoing support for feeds, working with Applications and client-facing teams.
Ensure clients can understand each product’s methodology, limitations, historical changes, and appropriate use cases.
Help build a repeatable experience for quant and systematic customers, including the data history, consistency, and transparency required for rigorous evaluation.

Connect Teams Around Shared Outcomes

Align priorities and responsibilities across Product, Data, Engineering, Research, Quant, Applications, and commercial teams.
Partner with Quant Research on systematic investor requirements and research-informed product improvements.
Work with data sourcing and partnerships teams to evaluate opportunities against customer needs, licensing constraints, quality, and economics.
Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, progress, and risks clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

Significant product management experience, typically 7+ years, including ownership of commercial data products, data feeds, or similarly data-intensive B2B products.
Experience directly managing and developing product managers, with evidence of improving both team performance and individual growth.
A track record of taking products from customer discovery through launch and scaling, with measurable customer and business outcomes.
Strong portfolio judgment: you can prioritize across products, allocate investment, and make difficult tradeoffs.
Commercial fluency, including experience contributing to pricing, packaging, revenue growth, retention, or product economics.
Hands-on analytical ability, including proficiency in SQL and comfort using Python to investigate data and assess product questions.
Technical fluency in data products, including schemas, methodologies, quality, delivery mechanisms, and the implications of product changes for clients.
Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align teams you do not directly manage.
A desire to remain a hands-on product owner while building and leading a team.

Experience with alternative data, financial data, or investment research products.
Familiarity with fundamental, quantitative, or systematic investment workflows, including dataset evaluation, backtesting, and integration.
Experience building a portfolio that serves multiple customer segments or combines multiple data sources.
Experience with third-party data partnerships, licensing considerations, and vendor dependencies.
Familiarity with APIs, cloud-based data delivery, and data quality and operational reliability practices.

new_jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Measurement
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Applecart
is the leading technology company that C-suites rely on to reach business-critical decision makers. The most important decisions are made by the hardest people to reach and influence. Historically, C-suite leaders have lacked the tools to reach the stakeholders who matter most to their business. The C-suites of hundreds of Fortune 500 companies, major agencies, trade associations, nonprofits, and governments use Applecart to put their best content in front of business-critical decision makers and those they trust — from policymakers and investors to CEOs, key employees, members of the media and more. Decision makers are informed by what they read, learn from advisors, hear from colleagues, and discuss with family and friends. To break through to them, you must reach them through the only channel that really moves them: those they know and trust. Applecart’s platform uses publicly available data to map billions of social relationships between nearly every American adult and enable clients to deliver content directly to decision makers and those who matter most to them.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management, Measurement in our New York City office.

About The Role

Our Decision Maker Targeting products are a critical part of our clients’ strategic execution. Applecart is used as an amplification layer for their ongoing communications with a broad cross-section of key stakeholders. Quantifying the impact of using Applecart audiences across all of these communication strategies is essential to our clients’ success.

In this critical role, you will drive the product vision and execution of our measurement and insights products as we grow our offering and client base. The ideal candidate would combine enterprise product expertise with a deep technical understanding of media measurement and/or research methods.

What You’ll Do

Define and build the next generation of our Measurement & Optimization offerings in collaboration with a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, product managers, and sales and client service leads
Own the product strategy, business planning, roadmap and requirements definition for your own product offering
Evangelize product solutions with internal teams, clients and industry partners
Collect user and client feedback via both direct and indirect channels and translate them into product requirements where applicable
Collaborate with key clients on implementation strategy and adoption of new features
Manage high visibility product launches and define and track KPIs to measure success and identify ongoing improvements
This role may also manage 1-2 Product Managers under them

Experiences And Capabilities You Bring

Experience and domain expertise:

8+ years of experience in a product management role, including 3+ years managing direct reports
Deep understanding of digital marketing, advertising technology, market research, or a similar industry, with specific expertise in media effectiveness measurement
Hands-on familiarity with the data that flows out of the ad tech stack — DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP), ad servers, and SSPs —including log-level/impression-level data, bid and delivery signals, and audience and taxonomy data
Personally rolled out measurement technology solutions to large enterprises and/or their agencies, owning both the client-facing reporting layer and the underlying methodology

Leading Mixed-discipline Teams

Proven track record leading mixed-discipline teams where you are the connective tissue between functions — partnering with data scientists on methodology and model validation, with analysts on insight generation and QA, with engineers on data pipelines and platform tradeoffs, and mentoring junior PMs on scoping and execution
You can translate a statistical approach into a client-ready narrative, and a client asks into a well-specified technical requirement
Experience working closely and managing asynchronous communication with a geographically distributed team

Technical Depth

Strong SQL — you write your own queries against large datasets to validate outputs, size opportunities, and debug discrepancies rather than waiting on a ticket
Experience owning products built on big-data platforms such as Spark/Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake, with a working understanding of batch vs. streaming, partitioning, cost/performance tradeoffs, and why a pipeline change can move a client-facing number
Experience shipping a client-facing application end to end — you have owned a standalone product surface, not just a reporting feed or an internal tool. That includes partnering with design on information architecture and UX for complex, data-dense interfaces; making deliberate calls on self-serve vs. guided workflows; and handling the realities of a production app such as onboarding, permissions and multi-tenancy, performance under real query loads, and instrumentation to understand how clients actually use it

This is a hybrid role. Work from home on Monday and Friday and in Applecart’s New York City office Tuesday through Thursday.

Compensation

Our compensation package consists of three components: (i) a base salary, (ii) annual cash bonus, and (iii) generous equity compensation.

The base salary range for this role is between $220,000 to $250,000, based on the candidate's experience and skills relative to the requirements listed above. The salary range provided is exclusive of discretionary annual cash bonus and equity compensation. The salary range provided for this role is specific to candidates located in the New York City area.

A Few Facts About Us

Applecart’s platform has been used by hundreds of industry-leading clients spanning Fortune 500 companies like Blackstone and Intuit, leading nonprofit organizations like the Environmental Defense Fund, and top-tier advertising and communications agencies like Teneo, FGS, Weber Shandwick, and OMD.
Applecart is growing quickly — over the last 4 years, we’ve increased our revenue by 10X, grown our headcount by almost 5X, and we’re cashflow positive.
Our senior leadership team includes two members of the Forbes 30 under 30 list for Marketing and Advertising, the former Head of Product at Moat, Oracle’s online ad measurement platform, a former senior White House advisor, early sales and talent leaders from Google and Twitter, two of the Democratic Party’s most successful pollsters and strategists, and alums of top-tier organizations like Bain & Company, Amazon and Simpson Thacher.
Applecart raised a $100M Series C from Blackstone’s tech growth fund at the end of 2025. The company’s other investors include Bain & Company, global sports, entertainment and marketing giant Endeavor, KKR Co-Founder Henry Kravis, entrepreneur Chris Burch, a founder of Palantir, senior engineering leaders at Twitter and Yelp, former Fortune 50 and advertising agency CEOs, and a number of well-known venture capitalists. Ari Emanuel, CEO of TKO and Executive Chairman of WME, Wayne Berman, Blackstone’s Head of Global Government Affairs, and Risa Heller, CEO of HELLER, serve on our board.
Our work has been featured on Morning Joe on MSNBC, BloombergTV, and The Colbert Report, and in Axios, Semafor, BusinessWeek, the Associated Press, Forbes, the Washington Post, and Politico, among many others.

Mid-market product-based businesses — manufacturers, distributors, and B2B and B2C commerce companies doing $2.5M–$100M in revenue — are one of the largest underserved opportunities in financial software. And yet most of them are running their finances on tools built for businesses nothing like theirs. That is the gap Intuit is building to fill.

Intuit's strategy is to become the financial operating system for this segment — delivering AI-powered financial intelligence and a connected ecosystem that makes Intuit the system of record mid-market operators build their stack around.

The financial burden is two-sided: inventory-based operations complexity — COGS, multi-location stock, purchase orders, landed costs — and product revenue complexity — deferred recognition, multi-element arrangements, and margin visibility by SKU, channel, and customer. Most have no system that handles both. That is the gap Intuit is building to fill.

As the Senior Staff Product Manager for Product-Based Businesses, you will own the strategy for product-based businesses — defining where Intuit plays, driving build, buy, and partner decisions, and converting high-value customers in partnership with Sales, Lighthouse, and Customer Success.

Define where Intuit plays in the mid-market product-based business segment — ICP, competitive positioning against ERP incumbents, and the build, buy, and partner decisions that sequence the roadmap.
Build the integration strategy across inventory, commerce, supply chain, and operations — making Intuit the financial hub mid-market customers build their stack around.

Deliver margin visibility by SKU, channel, and customer; cash flow forecasting; and variance analysis surfaced through natural language that replaces manual Excel modeling.
Partner with Lighthouse, Sales, and Customer Success to drive resolution on high-value escalations — translating customer friction into roadmap decisions that improve the product for the broader segment.

Qualifications

7+ years in product management with deep expertise in mid-market financial software, ERP, inventory management, or B2B SaaS serving product-based businesses.

Track record shipping AI-native products in production — writing agentic specs with objectives, tool definitions, confidence thresholds, and escalation logic.
Experience owning integration strategies across commerce, inventory, and supply chain platforms — and building the ecosystem partnerships that create structural lock-in at the mid-market.
Ability to operate across strategic and tactical registers — defining long-horizon vision while driving high-value customer escalations to resolution in partnership with Sales and Customer Success.

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
